# ufbx

The FBX and OBJ loader the Wallpaper Editor imports models with (`Packages/OWEEditor`,
`OWEModelImport`), as Wallpaper Engine's resource compiler imports them with Assimp.

| Library | Upstream | Version |
|---|---|---|
| ufbx | https://github.com/ufbx/ufbx | tag `v0.23.1` (commit `26a482ae66871d7de36eb722aa060bce95bce274`) |

The files are upstream's, unchanged: `ufbx.c` (SHA-256 `4a956c26a708e40d82ecb0aeaee54da709d5ba7c144c9642174970059bda7e1d`),
`include/ufbx.h` (`f787be529af577efc04f3e3e735844a08556718dbb613d1211c2b313d72895dc`) and `LICENSE`
(MIT, or public domain: the licensee's choice). Nothing is downloaded at run time.

## Refreshing

Download `ufbx.c`, `ufbx.h` and `LICENSE` from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ufbx/ufbx/<tag>/`,
replace these, and update the table and hashes above.
